name: LangSmith
description: Traces, runs and datasets in LangSmith.
long_description: LangSmith's hosted server. It reads traces and runs, searches them, and reads datasets and evaluation results — the record of what your LLM application actually did.

auth.instructions: Sign in to LangSmith in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reads your LangSmith traces and datasets, which contain whatever your application sent to a model.
